svg.title: Cleaning team, van and equipment in a tall pencil scene
svg.desc: Five cleaners stand in a staggered row behind a cleaning van, with every face and upper body visible. The van fills the middle of the scene, showing rear doors, windows and wheels. A mop, bucket, stocked cleaning caddy, spray bottles, folded towels and a canister vacuum fill the foreground. Blue hatching and thin ink strokes on a transparent background.
